description: This file implements the RFCManager class and related functions for managing RFC configurations, IARM bus interactions, network connectivity checks, and scheduling cron jobs within a C++ project.

classes.name: RFCManager
classes.description: Main class managing RFC operations, including network checks, IARM bus interactions, and scheduling.

methods.name: RFCManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing logger and IARM bus.

methods.name: IsIarmBusConnected
methods.description: Checks if the IARM bus is connected.

methods.name: InitializeIARM
methods.description: Initializes and connects to the IARM bus, registers event handlers.

methods.name: getErouterIPAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the eRouter IP address, preferring IPv6, then IPv4.

methods.name: CheckIPConnectivity
methods.description: Checks if the device has a valid eRouter IP address.

methods.name: CheckIProuteConnectivity
methods.description: Checks IP route configuration and network status from a specified file.

methods.name: isDnsResolve
methods.description: Checks if DNS nameserver IP is present in a given DNS config file.

methods.name: CheckDeviceIsOnline
methods.description: Determines if the device is online based on IP, route, and DNS configurations.

methods.name: SendEventToMaintenanceManager
methods.description: Sends events to the maintenance manager via IARM, if enabled.

methods.name: RFCManagerPostProcess
methods.description: Executes a script for post-processing if it exists.

methods.name: RFCManagerProcess
methods.description: Creates and processes a RuntimeFeatureControlProcessor object, handles success/failure, and sends related events.

methods.name: manageCronJob
methods.description: Schedules or updates a cron job based on a provided cron string, adjusting time by 3 minutes.
